executive_summary:
Episode 89 is structured as Candace Owens's open-letter response to a Truth Social post published by President Donald Trump attacking Tucker Carlson, Megyn Kelly, Candace Owens, and Alex Jones. The principal evidentiary artifacts presented on air are: the full text of Trump's Truth Social post (read aloud), a CNN-compiled montage of past Trump statements praising the same individuals, an audio clip of Megyn Kelly on Piers Morgan discussing the Iran situation-room meeting, a Tucker Carlson newsletter excerpt alleging Israeli blackmail of U.S. presidents, and an audio clip of Laura Loomer claiming credit for Trump's post.

The episode advances several persistent Bride of Charlie investigative threads. Most significant is Candace's on-air recounting of a pre-July-2024 conversation in which Charlie Kirk allegedly told her he and Andrew Kolb were present when Miriam Adelson offered Trump $100 million in exchange for West Bank annexation, and that Trump stated he intended to take the money and betray the Adelsons. Candace links this account to Trump's subsequent disinterest in the Butler, Pennsylvania investigation. The "Charlie would be on this list if they hadn't killed him" social-media response is highlighted as a recurring reaction to Trump's Truth Social post.

Structurally, the episode functions as a sustained on-air rebuttal whose evidentiary weight depends almost entirely on read-aloud or played-on-air artifacts (per the read/display rule), with the testimonial recount of the Adelson meeting standing as the single most consequential investigative claim advanced this episode.

claims.label: Trump Truth Social Post Targeted Tucker Carlson, Megyn Kelly, Candace Owens, and Alex Jones with "low IQ" / "nutjob" / "troublemaker" Language
claims.claim: Trump's Truth Social post, read in full on air, named Tucker Carlson, Megyn Kelly, Candace Owens, and Alex Jones and described them as "low IQ," "stupid people," "nutjobs," "troublemakers," and "losers."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Truth Social post via archived screenshots and confirm the verbatim text against the on-air reading.

claims.label: Trump Truth Social Post Described the United States as "the Hottest Country Anywhere in the World"
claims.claim: Trump's Truth Social post, read in full on air, characterized the United States as "the hottest country anywhere in the world."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact wording against the archived Truth Social post.

claims.label: CNN Compiled a Montage Showing Trump Previously Praising Candace Owens and Megyn Kelly
claims.claim: CNN assembled and aired a montage of past Trump appearances in which he praised Candace Owens, Megyn Kelly, and others as "stars" with "amazing reputations," contradicting his current posture in A-1939.1.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and verify the source clips used in the CNN compilation and their original air dates.

claims.label: Megyn Kelly Stated on Piers Morgan That Netanyahu Was Seated as an Equal to Trump in the Situation Room
claims.claim: In an on-air audio clip from her Piers Morgan interview, Megyn Kelly stated that Trump sat at the side of the situation-room table while Benjamin Netanyahu sat across from him as an equal, and that senior U.S. advisers subsequently informed Trump the stated Iran objectives were unattainable.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full Piers Morgan interview segment and verify the quoted claims; cross-reference with official White House situation-room imagery if available.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson Published a Letter Alleging Israel Has "a Storied History of Blackmailing US Presidents," Citing an Alleged Clinton-Lewinsky Recording Used to Free Jonathan Pollard
claims.claim: A letter/newsletter from Tucker Carlson, read in full on air, alleged that Israel has a "storied history of blackmailing US presidents," including the claim that recordings of Bill Clinton–Monica Lewinsky phone-sex sessions were used as leverage to obtain Jonathan Pollard's release.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Carlson newsletter post and verify the exact wording; assess sourcing and historical basis for the Clinton-Lewinsky blackmail claim independently.

claims.label: Laura Loomer Publicly Claimed Credit for Trump's Truth Social Post Targeting Tucker Carlson
claims.claim: In an audio clip played on air, Laura Loomer stated that she sent Tucker Carlson clips to President Trump and that she is the person who "knifed him from the front" via the resulting Truth Social post.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Loomer audio/video (e.g., X post, Rumble clip) and confirm the exact wording; assess whether other corroboration exists for her influence claim.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Told Candace Owens He and Andrew Kolb Were Present at a Meeting in Which Miriam Adelson Offered Trump $100M for West Bank Annexation
claims.claim: Candace Owens recounted on air that Charlie Kirk told her (with Andrew Kolb named as in-room corroborator) that he and Kolb were present at a meeting in which Miriam Adelson offered President Trump $100 million in exchange for annexation of the West Bank, prior to the public announcement of the donation in approximately July 2024.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and interview Andrew Kolb directly; cross-reference publicly reported Adelson-Trump meetings in spring/summer 2024; review contemporaneous meeting attendee records if obtainable.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Reported That Trump Said He Would Take Adelson's Money and Betray Her
claims.claim: Per Candace Owens's recounting of Charlie Kirk's account, Donald Trump stated during the meeting described in C-2675 that he intended to "take her money and then I'll f her over."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corroborating testimony from Andrew Kolb; review any contemporaneous notes, messages, or secondary witnesses; assess downstream policy decisions vis-à-vis West Bank actions.

claims.label: Donald Trump Jr. Publicly Stated His Father Was Satisfied with the Butler Investigation Conclusion Despite His Own Dissatisfaction
claims.claim: Donald Trump Jr. stated on stage that he was not satisfied with the conclusion of the Butler, Pennsylvania investigation but that his father was satisfied and the matter was closed.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original on-stage footage or transcript; cross-reference with any subsequent Trump Jr. statements on the same topic.

claims.label: A Significant Segment of Self-Identified MAGA Supporters Publicly Turned Against Trump Following the Truth Social Post
claims.claim: Truth Social and broader social-media responses read on air (A-1946.1), supplemented by viewer comments (A-1945.1), indicate a measurable volume of previously pro-Trump MAGA supporters publicly criticizing or repudiating him following A-1939.1.
claims.investigative_direction: Quantify sentiment shift using archived social-media datasets and date-range filters; separate organic supporter sentiment from bot/inauthenticator activity.

claims.label: A Recurring Social-Media Response Claimed "Charlie Would Be on This List if They Hadn't Killed Him"
claims.claim: Candace Owens highlighted as the most "brutal" recurring response a claim, posted by multiple users, that Charlie Kirk would have been on Trump's target list in A-1939.1 had he not been killed.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the originating posts and timestamps; assess spread velocity and authorship clustering.

claims.label: Trump Simultaneously Cited CNN Polls and Labeled CNN "Fake News" in A-1939.1
claims.claim: Trump's Truth Social post cited CNN polling data ("100% approval rating") while concurrently describing CNN as "fake news."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact wording in the archived post and identify the specific CNN poll Trump cited.

claims.label: Trump's Truth Social Post Asserted That Brigitte Macron Is "a Far More Beautiful Woman Than Candace"
claims.claim: Trump's Truth Social post stated, verbatim, that the first lady of France is "a far more beautiful woman than Candace" and "it's not even close."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact wording against the archived post.
